review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, regression design self-review
review.decision: Keep scrollback independent of the height of the mobile Live overlay
review.notes: Implementation owner reviewed the released viewport-only slice. Exercise the rendered scroll content, capture turnover and scope reset. Gesture physics and device frame time require native acceptance. Reviewed the combined overlay on the merged scrollback baseline. Its held frame must survive status redraws and clear after pane access loss; the idle resize assertion now checks the selected height.

cases.description: The live terminal grip grows upward and reveals earlier lines within the Chat viewport
cases.setup: Open a synthetic working conversation with more than 40 captured rows. Supply a measured Chat viewport, then a smaller one.
cases.action: Use the resize responder and its accessible increase/decrease actions. Inspect measured preview bounds and visible lines.
cases.expected: The grip shares the header row with the status and close control, with a 44-point touch target. Upward drag expands the panel and shows earlier captured output while retaining the latest row. Downward drag shrinks it. Viewport changes clamp the effective height and restoring space restores the selected size. Accessible actions use the same bounds.

cases.description: Preview resizing stays with the current live conversation scope
cases.setup: Open a working conversation, resize it, and refresh its capture. Offer an idle observation and then a different conversation.
cases.action: Fold and reopen the preview, transiently hide the working row, and switch to another pane.
cases.expected: The selection survives redraw, folding and temporary idle within the same scope. A new scope starts folded at its default size. Resizing does not create an input action or change pane identity.

cases.description: Opening, dragging and closing Live do not reflow the conversation or change its reading position
cases.setup: Render a working conversation with turns, measured status row and floating controls. Scroll away from the tail.
cases.action: Open Live, invoke a resize gesture, then close it. Inspect the conversation scroll subtree, measured footer space, fold control and reported reading state.
cases.expected: Only the collapsed row occupies layout space in the transcript. The expanded card sits above the composer and below the top controls as a sibling layer with an opaque surface. Its resize leaves the scroll subtree, footer space and reading state stable. The fixed fold action keeps its normal touch target and the closed Live disclosure returns.

cases.description: Mobile Live retains a bounded scrollable capture while the reader browses earlier output
cases.setup: Open the working Chat overlay with more than 1,000 numbered capture lines.
cases.action: Browse away from the tail, replace the capture, resize the panel and return to the tail. Close and reopen.
cases.expected: Up to the latest 1,000 captured lines are available at any panel height. Older rows remain readable during polling, returning to the tail shows the current capture, and reopening starts live.
